title: Closing thanks and San Antonio recognition
summary: The interviewer thanks him; Albert mentions an article on San Antonio's lack of recognition and attorney Maury Maverick.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Well, we only have a few seconds left, so I wanted to thank you again for everything, and I'm glad we got this done. I hope we can do a good article.

Well, I hope so, and I most certainly want you to read this article, or I'm going to give it to you. Now, Mario Maverick is an attorney, and he is a civil rights, he's a white attorney, but he is a civil rights advocate. And he has fought this thing down the line. That's the reason why you notice that the article will be pointing to why San Antonio doesn't recognize Don Albert any more than they do. You'll notice that it's not a direct accusation, but it's in there. Mm-hmm.
